title: The Ethics of ChatGPT in Medicine and Healthcare: A Systematic Review on Large Language Models (LLMs)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the ethical implications of LLMs in medicine and healthcare, such as fairness, bias, privacy, and accuracy. It makes a passing reference to a study about LLMs associating Muslims with violence as an example of broader harms, but does not analyze this further.
